text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: paging integration failing in prod. Several pages dropped by the notify-proxy. Attempting automated retry, suppression window detected. (alert_id=inc-2024-11-05-09)
eng-nick: copying the logs now, looks like webhook worker got a 403 from pager service repeatedly.
oncall-jordan: i didn't receive the page for this alert. was oncall muted? @incident-bot shows delivered, but phone silent.
sre-tim: checking delivery logs + health of incident-bot workers. can someone confirm whether the signing key rotated earlier?
ops-sara: we rotated signing key for pagerflow at 08:50 UTC per changelog, but rollout should've been backwards compatible. will check.
eng-nick: stack traces show header missing x-pager-signature for ~30s window.
eng-nick: snippet from notify-proxy logs:
```
2024-11-05T09:12:03Z ERROR notify-proxy delivery failed id=abc123 status=403 body="signature-mismatch"
2024-11-05T09:12:04Z WARN automation suppress window start id=abc123 reason="auth-failures"
```
oncall-jordan: that matches the timeframe i missed the page.
sre-tim: immediate mitigation: routing to manual SMS fallback for high-severity pages and triggering a durable retry queue.
pm-leah: customer-impact? paging reliability customer reported missed oncall for a trial today.
ops-sara: one customer reported delayed response for an internal incident. looks like <=10% of pages in the window failed. not widespread.
eng-nick: hotfix plan: revert signing key or accept both keys in verification layer for 10m then rotate properly.
eng-nick: i'll push a canary that accepts both keys and restarts the webhook worker.
sre-tim: doing a rolling restart of incident-bot workers now, patch applied to 2/3 hosts, monitoring.
incident-bot: SYSTEM: worker restart triggered by @sre-tim. Restart completed on host-12, host-13 pending.
oncall-jordan: after restart i just got two test pages (manual). confirm on my end pages resumed.
eng-nick: canary looks good, no more 403s in the last 45s. switching rollout to full.
ops-sara: switching high-severity route to SMS-fallback until full rollout completes. manual pages queued and sent.
pm-leah: logging a quick customer note and follow-up email. cc: support.
sre-tim: post-incident action items: (1) add key-rollover test to pre-rollout checklist, (2) add metric for auth-failures on notify-proxy, (3) implement safer dual-key acceptance with expiry.
eng-nick: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/notify-proxy/accept-dual-signing-key (short-lived ack), will auto-revert after 12m.
ops-sara: monitoring shows success rate back to 99.9% rolling 5m window.
oncall-jordan: thanks all. please update the incident timeline in the retro doc and tag me for follow-up on SLA notification.
eng-nick: adding retro notes + adding snippet of logs to the ticket.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: paging integration degraded -> mitigation applied (accept-dual-key canary + worker restarts) at 09:15 UTC. Please file a postmortem if customer impact > minor.
pm-leah: created ticket INC-5408 and assigned PM+SRE. will draft customer-facing summary.
eng-nick: follow-up: schedule a runbook update so shift oncall knows manual SMS fallback steps.
sre-tim: closing slack thread, moving to postmortem channel after we sync.
ops-sara: :thumbsup: thanks team.
